CA.rationale: Content (red assignment) is explicitly paired with a command_estimate origin (processing condition) for the same record.

COD.rationale: Content (red assignment), its organization/presentation (origin metadata), and a separate status/organization marker are explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: A processing condition (command_estimate) is explicitly attached to the same content record, qualifying as a content-processing condition linked to presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple report lines identify content sets (red/blue) for explicit referents and times.

D.rationale: The text separates content identification (red set) from its status/organization (origin metadata) for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: Origin and represented_time fields describe how the content is represented/presented (record kind and time).
